content:
At the time of arrival Nino was on site with his external support worker. Writer received hand over Nino just arrived. 
Nino spend time watching TV. 
Writer prepared dinner and served to Nino. Nino had his evening meds.
Nino had apple. Latter had milk and biscuits.
Other staff supported with shower. Nino came out and watched TV. 
Staff encouraged Nino to go to bed. Night meds were given by other staff.
nil concern

At the time of arrival Nino was on site and was waiting for his CSW . Writer received hand over that no csw is here, yet Nini has been waiting.
After long wait Nino's mum was informed. Mum said she is coming to pick Nino. 
Admin was informed. Mum and Nino sister came. Writer handed oved webster pack with evening and night meds. Writer handed over Nino's bag to mum . Mum took empty boxes and dirty clothes.
Mum will send back the clothes tomorrow. 
Nino was in happy mood. 
Nil concerns

6am to 10am
 Upon arrival client was sleeping peacefully. Staff woke Nino at 8:30am and said good morning and Staff asked Nino to go to the bathroom and wash his face. 
After that, staff asked Nino to change from pyjamas into pants, hoodie, and shoes. Staff asked Nino to put laundry in the washing machine and he did. 

Staff asked Nino what he wanted for breakfast. Nino asked for toasted bread with butter and vegetables. Breakfast was served with one glass of water. After eating, staff asked Nino to put dishes in the dishwasher. 
Staff gave Nino his medication. Staff asked Nino to sit down and watch TV. Nino followed all instructions.   Nino was started  bitting his hand staff  try to distract him .CP staff arrived 9 am .Cp staff took him out . Handover provided to next .

At the time of arrival Nino was away with his CSW, Nino came back at 4pm . Nino's bag and webster pack was handed over and was kept in safe. 
Nino looked calm. Nino watched TV and put the volume up few times. Writer gently asked Nino to put the volume down. Nino did that.
Writer supported with dinner and evening meds.
2xstaff supported with shower and night suit dressing 
Nil concerns

At the time of arrival, Nino was away with his CSW. Nino arrived at 3.30pm 
Nino's CSW stayed for some time and left. Nino's BSP Avan came at 4pm. Avan spent time with Nino and mentioned, Nino needs to writer what he would like to eat during the week and should be written on his white board.
Writer handed over in the group. And handed over to night staff. 
Nino had his dinner and evening meds. 
Nino was running around, few times he was loud. No aggressive behaviour was observed.

6 to 12pm
Upon arrival Nino was sleeping. Morning medication was administered as prescribed. Client continued sleeping until 8:50am and woke independently.

Staff prompted client to use the bathroom, make bed, and wash face. Client completed all tasks independently. Client then ran to the lounge area and sat on the couch. Staff encouraged client to change clothes, but client declined and did not change.
Staff asked client for breakfast preference. Client requested toasted bread with veggies, Vegemite, and butter. One glass of water was provided. Breakfast was placed on the table and client was called to eat. Client was watching TV and did not respond initially. After 10 minutes client came to the table, had breakfast, placed dish in the dishwasher, and returned to watching TV.

Staff cleaned client bathroom. Bathroom was found messy with bowel open in pan area.
Around 10:40am client began agitating, screaming, and biting his hand. Staff attempted to distract client, but behaviors continued. PRN medication was administered as per care plan at 10:50am. Following PRN, client settled and continued watching TV.

Staff prompted client to get dressed and ready for the day. Client dressed independently. Staff asked for lunch options. Client requested pizza, which was provided. At end of shift client was still eating. 
Handover provided to next staff. 

Client was monitored throughout shift .

At the time of arrival. Noni was on site with his External support worker. Noni left at 2.15pm 
Tonight Noni will stay at his mum .
Writer washed Noni's clothes

6am to 10am
 Upon arrival client was sleeping peacefully. Staff woke Nino at 7:40am and said good morning and Staff asked Nino to go to the bathroom and wash his face. 
After that, staff asked Nino to change from pyjamas into pants, hoodie, and shoes. Staff asked Nino to put laundry in the washing machine and he did. 

Staff asked Nino what he wanted for breakfast. Nino asked for toasted bread with butter and vegetables. Breakfast was served with one glass of water. After eating, staff asked Nino to put dishes in the dishwasher. 
Staff gave Nino his medication. Staff asked Nino to sit down and watch TV. Nino followed all instructions.  While nino was roaming  staff monitored him and asked him to sit down and show some things around .CP staff arrived 9 am .Cp staff took him out .

CP staff arrived. Handover provided.

Nino arrived at 3.45pm with his CSW Tony. 
Writer supported to bring stuff in. Writer greeted Nino and introduced herself. 
Tony supported Nino to organize his stuff in his room. All the food was kept in fridge by writer. Nino's munching stuff id in top cupboard up on fridge.  
Nino watched Tv and observed get excited many times. However no challenging behaviour was observed.
Writer served dinner and dinner meds were administered.
Writer gave hand over to other staff. Writer showed where the meds are kept, Nino will be out with external SW from 9am to 4pm , Medication chart is not available yet .

At 9.20 pm writer was making notes, other staff went to toilet, Writer heard some noises, Writer went out and saw Nino was running with bag, Darrell was after him. Darrell thought that. that was his bag , Nino hold Darrell's both hands. However, both staff encourage Darrell and Nino, to leave each other. Situation was controlled.
concerns: Bit of conflict with other participant
